segments.name: Snack food products
segments.description: Manufactures, distributes, markets and sells branded and non-branded salty snacks to retailers and distributors across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable segment: the manufacturing, distribution, marketing and sale of snack food products.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net sales from selling salty snack products to grocery, mass merchant, club, convenience, drug and other retailers through direct shipments, distributors and DSD routes.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are distributed nationally to grocery, mass merchant, club, convenience, drug and other retailers through direct shipments, distributors and approximately 2,500 direct-store delivery ("DSD") routes.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company sold the Good Health and R.W. Garcia brands and related manufacturing facilities to affiliates of Our Home.
changes.evidence: On February 5, 2024, the Company sold certain assets and brands to affiliates of Our Home™, an operating company of Better-for-You brands ("Our Home").

changes.text: In 2024, the Company also sold its Berlin, PA and Fitchburg, MA manufacturing facilities and certain related assets to Our Home.
changes.evidence: On April 22, 2024, the Company also sold to Our Home its Berlin, PA and Fitchburg, MA manufacturing facilities and certain related assets, including certain inventory (the "Manufacturing Facilities Sale").
